purpose: Upgrade the preserved BTC/ETH hold baseline to actual5m marks, exact funding and independently filled segregated cash accounts; compare one cost-conditioned variant within the same funding mechanism. Hybrid diversification research, not a replacement for primary perpetual alpha or a claim of independent new factor discovery.
baseline: Same25percent aggregate spot /70percent futures wallet /5percent residual-cash initial allocation as old hold baseline, equally split fixed assets; preserve net base quantity except risk reductions. No increase from old0.5initial gross to chase return. Weekly Monday00:00UTC entry review, no periodic forced close and no upward rebalancing existing positions.

condition.entry: past28day settled rate sum times60/28 exceeds1.25times stress four-leg roundtrip rate cost; uses only events available after5minutes; otherwise cash; exit condition must be inactive
condition.exit: on weekly review past7day settled rate sum negative; entry/exit thresholds frozen once, no search or fitted predictor

execution: Submit after observable decision; fill independently at next5m completed-bar trade close with side-specific slippage and each actual5m1percent quote-volume cap. Equal desired net base quantities; a partial or missing leg causes queued full unwind in subsequent intervals. Spot buy fee charged in base, spot sell fee in quote; no futures short-sale proceeds credited. No atomic hedge or imaginary spot mark cash transfer.
funding: Exact eventTime and actual markPrice; prior inventory receives or pays events in(start,end] before fills at the bar end. Newly entered inventory receives nothing at the same settlement instant. Preserve events and wallet source in ledger.
risk: Futures wallet cash is segregated from spot assets and free quote cash. Transfers only at initialisation or fully flat weekly review, with both wallets journalled; no intrahold assumption of instantaneous spot-gain collateral. Mark OHLC high plus non-positive in-bar funding gives conservative futures margin envelope; possible maintenance breach is a hard qualification failure, never interpreted as a verified exchange liquidation model. Margin<20percent,5m NAV drawdown15percent or conservative spot-low/perp-high stress envelope15percent halts new entries and requests delayed unwind. Gross drift>0.8 requests proportional reduction toward0.5. Intrabar envelopes are conservative nonsynchronous bounds, not exact tick drawdown.
end_boundary: At each registered terminal boundary, request whole-book unwind one interval before end. Retain any capacity-limited residual as marked inventory with exit reserve; do not invent liquidation fills. Continuation tests split the same unmodified full-account schedule, not concatenated cold windows.
capacity_followup: At most two continuous608day candidates with positive marked and closed PnL in both costs and no risk-path flags; this only selects finite capacity diagnostics, never admission or economic independence.
